title: Oasis 2027 Tour – Ticket, Setlist & Festival Rumours: Our Six Biggest Questions
summary: The band are heading on a triumphant victory lap in 2027. Here's what we're wondering about going into the upcoming run.
contentText:
Oasis is going back on tour in 2027 , with a victory lap taking in stadiums across the U.K., Ireland, mainland Europe, and two U.S. cities, Boston and Las Vegas.

The shows have been teased and reported on for some time, pretty much since Noel and Liam Gallagher’s reconciliation on their epic 2025 reunion tour , which kicked off in Cardiff, Wales, on July 4. The 41-show run was their first together in 16 years following their 2009 breakup, coming after years of public sniping as they embarked on divergent, yet successful, solo careers.

When they announced those comeback shows back in August 2024, fans and critics alike raised serious questions : What songs would they play live? Who would join them in the band? Would they even make it to the end of the tour? The success of that run – documented this month in the stellar film Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger – put those concerns to rest, turning the performances into an emotional love-in between the once-estranged brothers and their diehard fans.

Thankfully, Live ‘27 doesn’t carry the same sense of jeopardy. Noel and Liam have proven they can still dominate the mainstream conversation, driving a massive boost for their catalog and global reputation. Their relationship appears to be at its strongest in decades, giving these upcoming shows a celebratory atmosphere free from the previous skepticism.

However, based on past events and the current slate, key questions remain. Billboard U.K. breaks down the main talking points for the 2027 run, including potential setlists, festival rumors, and whether this will be the band’s final outing.
